purpose: Evaluate start-date robustness of two already frozen pre-2025 specifications. This batch performs no tuning, winner selection, parameter adjustment, resampling, or production change.

execution.initial_state: empty portfolio and no pending orders
execution.fees_slippage_corporate_actions_delistin: identical to the Batch004/Batch006 raw-price corporate-action audit

start_sampling.algorithm: Create one numpy Generator(PCG64(20261019)); iterate years ascending; for each year build the sorted unique execution trading dates from January 1 through March 31 inclusive, draw 20 integer positions using Generator.choice(n, size=20, replace=false), and sort the selected dates ascending for storage and execution.

run_window.last_signal_date_each_year: calendar year end minus 37 calendar days
run_window.reason_for_37_days: allow the fixed seven-calendar-day entry-order lifetime plus thirty-calendar-day holding horizon to mature
run_window.execution_end: last trading day of the same calendar year
run_window.required_terminal_state: zero open positions and zero pending orders
run_window.unexitable_objective_halt_or_other_termi: record the run as failed/anomalous; never silently drop it

per_year_per_version: variance check equal to std squared
reporting.overall_per_version_across_100_runs: same metrics; do not label as CAGR because run holding lengths differ
